reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off, and the 25-kid cap are exactly what I look for, and a gated Baby Nook for my 10-month-old is rare. The first visit is free, so I'd go look at it myself, and if it's clean I'd pay for a couple of drop-ins.
objection: A log on a wall is just paper. I need to see it is actually clean, with the toys wiped and the floors clean, and the reviews to say so, because my toddler puts everything in her mouth. I also wouldn't commit to a membership before I've seen it a few times.
would_change_my_mind: If the free visit showed grubby toys, a stale log, or lots of sick-looking kids, I'd not come back. Solid local reviews from other parents mentioning cleanliness would make me buy sooner.
